title: K-07 完整流程：重定向目标解析到内网时拒绝

cases.name: redirect-to-internal
cases.code:
import sys, json
from urllib.request import Request
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import identity_check as ic
handler = ic._SafeRedirectHandler()
orig = ic.validate_url
def fake(url, resolver=None):
    return orig(url, resolver=lambda *a, **k: [(2, 1, 6, '', ('10.0.0.5', 0))])
ic.validate_url = fake
try:
    handler.redirect_request(Request('https://example.com/'), None, 302, '', {}, 'https://evil.example/')
    print(json.dumps({'status': 'ok'}))
except ic.UnsafeUrl as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'status': 'unsafe', 'reason': exc.reason}))
